description: Cross-vertical event timeline for one real-world entity — joins SEC filings/insider/Form144/13D + FDA recalls + FDA drug labels + federal contracts into one ordered feed. Use this when an LLM needs the FULL picture of a company across regulatory verticals. Add min_importance to filter to high-signal events only.

days.description: Calendar-day lookback for dated events; some sources have no date filter. Default 180, max 730.

key.description: Ticker, 10-digit CIK, UEI, LEI, DUNS, or numeric entity_id (e.g. 'PFE')

limit.description: Maximum events in the final sorted timeline; default 100, max 500.

min_importance.description: 0-100. Class I recall=100, 13D=75, large Form 144=75, insider buy=50, 8-K=35.

name: entity_timeline
title: Get Entity Timeline
